requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield. CMY bottle size must support yields greater than 8K pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market demand for higher yield and to remain competitive in the CISS segment against competitors like Epson.
requirements.Stakeholders: R&D, Product Management, SMB, Enterprise Customers
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with current ink delivery system (IDS) and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles deliver minimum 6K Black and 6K CMY page yields; CMY bottle size supports >8K pages; successful integration with IDS; validated by page yield testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottle Refilling
requirements.Description: Ensure the bottle refilling process is spill-free to enhance user experience and reduce maintenance issues.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation reduces customer complaints and service costs, and improves product reputation.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of bottle, tank interface, and NOA-F components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Refill process passes spill-free reliability tests under defined use cases; no spills reported in pilot testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Incorporate a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label into the NOA-F component, with no changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and traceability without impacting existing mechanisms, supporting service and warranty.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing NOA-F design, compatibility with push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F produced with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, passes all reliability and compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer to support customer replaceable PHA and NOA-F components for improved serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs, increases uptime, and aligns with customer expectations for easy maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F component design, user documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F without special tools; replacement process validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages to meet increased reliability expectations.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market requirements and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability, consumables life, service parts availability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes accelerated life testing for 80K pages with no major failures; warranty documentation updated.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure that the PDL SKU meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and efficiency requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Compliance with environmental standards is necessary for market access and corporate responsibility.
requirements.Dependencies: Design, materials selection, documentation for certification.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel; certificates available before product launch.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize printer size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and minimizes product footprint while supporting larger tanks.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design, platform mechanical constraints.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays redesigned and validated for tank protrusion; tested for paper handling and durability.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD User Interface
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) as the main user interface for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and aligns with competitive products in the segment.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, UX/UI Team, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Display sourcing, firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD fully functional, passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement enhanced aerosol management in the service station to accommodate changes due to the new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces contamination, improves reliability, and meets regulatory/environmental requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station design, tank integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels within defined limits during operation; system passes reliability and environmental tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign the paper path to support increased page life consistent with the new 80K page warranty goal.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and reduces maintenance over the product’s life.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path design, component durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes accelerated life and reliability testing for 80K pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80K Life)
requirements.Description: Design the ink maintenance system as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80K page life.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended product life and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance system design, service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced at service centers; process validated and documented.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce new 140ml black bottles and appropriately sized CMY bottles to support higher yields and optimize cost per page.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yields and meets evolving market demands.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, tank compatibility, supply chain readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 140ml K bottles and new CMY bottles available at launch; validated for compatibility and yield.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS (Ink Delivery System) startup algorithm and improved air management for reliable operation.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances startup reliability and reduces service incidents related to air in the system.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, firmware development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management implemented; system passes reliability and startup tests.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with updated page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality throughout the product’s life and aligns with warranty claims.
requirements.Dependencies: PQ testing, firmware updates, consumables tracking.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion metrics defined, implemented, and validated by testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL and Associated Components
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Hi PDL, dASIC, aASIC, PSU, and Wi-Fi modules to optimize development cost and time.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D costs, leverages proven components, and accelerates time-to-market.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new platform and features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components integrated and validated for performance and reliability.

requirements.Title: Security Compliance with Gauss4.xx
requirements.Description: Ensure hardware and firmware security compliance using Gauss4.xx standards.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses enterprise and SMB security requirements and protects HP’s reputation.
requirements.Stakeholders: IT Security, Enterprise Customers, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and hardware design, compliance testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes Gauss4.xx security compliance testing; documentation complete.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for improved ink flow and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Improves system reliability and supports new tank and bottle designs.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design, platform integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube routing implemented and validated for flow rate and reliability.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service) Business Model
requirements.Description: Enable features and infrastructure to support PaaS, including onboarding paths for Consumer, HPX, SMB, and Enterprise segments.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports evolving business models.
requirements.Dependencies: Cloud services, onboarding workflow, client integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features available and validated for all onboarding paths; business model operational at launch.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB/Enterprise Manageability
requirements.Description: Provide integrated scan solutions and manageability features for SMB and Enterprise customers, including WJA, HPSM, and JAM support.
requirements.Rationale: Meets the needs of business customers for device management and workflow integration.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, client software, backend integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan solution and manageability features implemented and validated with target clients.

requirements.Title: Business Priority Matrix Alignment
requirements.Description: Adhere to the business priority matrix: Schedule and SuperAmp PHA life (65K) are least flexible, warranty life (2 years), throughput (25/20 ppm), serviceability, SMB solution, and PaaS are to be optimized, while host 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K are flexible.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures focus on critical business drivers and aligns development with strategic goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Project management, resource allocation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Project milestones and deliverables align with priority matrix; reviewed at each checkpoint.
